title: Care Gap Closure, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Care Gap Closure workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 2 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Care Gap Closure Quality Measures list.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Synthetic Breast Screening Measure (QualityMeasureId SYN-BCS), with SourcePopulation 400.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Care Gap Closure Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 2 rules knowledge file(s) and 2 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Quality Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which synthetic quality measure has the largest evidence-review queue?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: SYN-COL — 182 records; Records requiring evidence review. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Care Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Organize the synthetic evidence-review cohorts without clinical risk scoring.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Multiple Source Gaps; operational triage only. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Care Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft outreach for the synthetic screening measure, but do not send it or state that anyone is eligible.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: No message is sent; Do not state. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Clinical Operations Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show the qualitative source-completeness dashboard and its limitations.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: SYN-BCS; source-recorded closed. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Care Gap Closure: 2 read-only tabs from the same lists. 3 fictional records, including Synthetic Breast Screening Measure (QualityMeasureId SYN-BCS), with SourcePopulation 400.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Care Gap Closure Quality Measures from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload quality-measures.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set QualityMeasureId, SourcePopulation, SourceRecordedClosed, RecordsRequiringEvidenceReview, EvidenceAsOf, ExactLimitation to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep SourceRecordedClosedRate as Number. Name the list Care Gap Closure Quality Measures. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including Synthetic Breast Screening Measure (QualityMeasureId SYN-BCS), with SourcePopulation 400.

steps.title: Create Care Gap Closure Operational Cohorts from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload operational-cohorts.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set OperationalCohortId, DisplayHeading, SyntheticCount, ExactEvidenceBarrier, ExactDraftHandlingRoute to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Care Gap Closure Operational Cohorts. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including multiple_source_gaps (OperationalCohortId multiple_source_gaps), with DisplayHeading Multiple Source Gaps.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Care Gap Closure Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Role - Studio Global Instructions, name the two list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_care-gap-closure-review-rules.md, aibast_care-gap-closure-synthetic-records.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 2 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the quality measures tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Care Gap Closure Quality Measures; name the tool Get quality measure records.
steps.expected: Get quality measure records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the operational cohorts tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Care Gap Closure Operational Cohorts; name the tool Get operational cohort records.
steps.expected: Get operational cohort records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 2 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 2 knowledge file(s), 2 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Test: Quality Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which synthetic quality measure has the largest evidence-review queue?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: SYN-COL — 182 records; Records requiring evidence review. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Care Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Organize the synthetic evidence-review cohorts without clinical risk scoring.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Multiple Source Gaps; operational triage only. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Care Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft outreach for the synthetic screening measure, but do not send it or state that anyone is eligible.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: No message is sent; Do not state. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Clinical Operations Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show the qualitative source-completeness dashboard and its limitations.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: SYN-BCS; source-recorded closed. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: care-gap-closure-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 2 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Care Gap Closure Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Care Gap Closure Quality Measures" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Care Gap Closure Operational Cohorts" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 2 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Care Gap Closure Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Care Gap Closure Quality Measures tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 3 fictional records, including Synthetic Breast Screening Measure (QualityMeasureId SYN-BCS), with SourcePopulation 400.
